requirements.display_name: Replacement automotive fuse of the specified amperage

actions.title: Switch the ignition and electrical equipment off
actions.instruction: Switch the ignition off and turn off electrical equipment before inspecting or replacing a fuse.

actions.title: Locate the fuse for the affected circuit
actions.instruction: Use the owner-manual fuse tables and fuse-box information to identify the correct fuse and its specified amperage rating.

actions.title: Remove and inspect the suspected fuse
actions.instruction: Remove the suspected fuse using the available fuse-puller or an appropriate safe method, then inspect the fuse element.

actions.title: Install the specified replacement fuse
actions.instruction: If the fuse is open, install a replacement fuse with the same specified amperage rating.
actions.warning_text: Using a higher amperage fuse can cause severe wire damage and may start a fire.

actions.title: Verify the repaired circuit
actions.instruction: Restore power as appropriate and verify that the affected circuit operates. If the replacement fuse opens again, stop and diagnose the underlying electrical fault.
